crossRefs.note: Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.
This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

translations.web: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”
translations.bsb: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
translations.kjv: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
translations.asv: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.
